items.difficulty_reason: Base-change lemma for modules (statement 1655-1661, proof 1663-1679): the ringed-site base change isomorphism - the proof notes g_n^* = g_n^{-1} with the exactness consequences, forms the canonical base change map, and identifies it in the derived category with the abelian-case map via the modules-abelian-unbounded lemma, transferring the already-proven abelian isomorphism; the reduction is executed in-span. H2.
